cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Committee,

I am a computer engineer and lecturer who has spent the last few years designing NLP models for ranking and evaluation. In my PhD work I created hybrid metrics that combine extractive summarisation with large language models, and I built the data pipelines and evaluation framework that support them. At Toros University I led a team that built classification and retrieval tools for medical documents, turning research prototypes into usable services for students and clinicians.

My research on trustworthy AI required me to measure precision, latency and inference cost, and to set up continuous evaluation pipelines that catch regressions. I have written production-grade Python code, integrated PyTorch-based models in research notebooks, and coordinated deployments with cloud resources during summer schools and COST projects. These experiences match the need to improve search relevance with embeddings, hybrid search and reranking.

Beyond the technical work I have coordinated international academic activities and managed a tech-startup, giving me a practical view of user-centric product development. I enjoy turning research insights into tools that people can use every day, and I look forward to bringing that mindset to Actcareers' proactive applications.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to discussing how my background in ranking, retrieval and trustworthy AI can help your team deliver reliable, low-latency models.

Best regards,
Anıl Kuş
